description: This file defines a broker service class for orchestrating paper trading operations, including initiating trades, querying balance and positions, and placing orders within a simulated trading environment.

classes.name: BrokerService
classes.description: Provides methods to run paper trading simulations, manage broker states, and execute trading orders.

methods.name: __init__(self, settings: Settings)
methods.description: Initializes the BrokerService with provided settings, instantiates RLService and a single PaperBroker instance.

methods.name: tuple[str,str] paper_trade( self, policy_path: Optional[str] = None, capital: float = 100000.0, risk_per_trade: float = 0.01 )
methods.description: Runs a basic paper trading simulation, generating a unique run ID and returning results path.

methods.name: float get_balance(self)
methods.description: Returns the current balance of the paper broker.

methods.name: int get_positions(self)
methods.description: Returns the current open positions of the paper broker.

methods.name: tuple[str,float,int] place_order(self, side: str, quantity: int, price: float)
methods.description: Places a simulated buy or sell order with validation and returns order ID, updated balance, and positions.
